commits_data.title: infiniband: allow sub-dissectors to reassemble RC Send PDUs
commits_data.message:
infiniband: allow sub-dissectors to reassemble RC Send PDUs

A sub-dissector can set info->do_rc_send_reassembling = true
if it was passed in as false. It means it will
be recalled once all RC_SEND* fragments are reassambled.

If info->do_rc_send_reassembling is already true
the passed tvb is already reassambled.

The smb-direct dissector will make use of this in the
next commit.

Signed-off-by: Stefan Metzmacher <metze@samba.org>
